WITH patient_lab_join AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    p.SEX,
    l.PT,
    l.IGA,
    l.IGM,
    CASE WHEN l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL THEN l.IGA - l.IGM ELSE NULL END AS iga_igm_diff
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(PT) AS avg_pt,
    AVG(iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff
  FROM patient_lab_join
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(iga_igm_diff) AS overall_mean_diff
  FROM patient_lab_join
),
patient_with_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.ID,
    pa.SEX,
    pa.avg_pt,
    pa.avg_iga_igm_diff,
    CASE 
      WHEN pa.avg_iga_igm_diff IS NOT NULL AND om.overall_mean_diff IS NOT NULL AND om.overall_mean_diff != 0
      THEN pa.avg_iga_igm_diff / om.overall_mean_diff 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio
  FROM patient_avgs pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
)
SELECT 
  SEX,
  AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt_by_sex,
  AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff_by_sex,
  AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_by_sex
FROM patient_with_ratios
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;
